listing.name: [WIP] San Batavia Republic 0.3
listing.summary: Adds the San Batavia Republic faction with custom ships, fighters, and portraits.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the San Batavia Republic faction with custom ships, fighters, and portraits.

description:
Quote

"We declare that the San Batavia Republic, seeing no hope of reconciliation, and finding no other remedy, have, agreeable to the law of nature and stars, in their own defense, and for maintaining the rights, privileges, and liberties of their countrymen, wives, children and siblings, and latest posterity from being enslaved by the invaders, bandits and looters, been forced to take up arms to defend those. Know all men and women on earth - by these words we unanimously and deliberately declare, that the San Batavia Republic come to be, under rule of new, fair government which according to heavens and beliefs of the people shall rule it, maintaining sovereignty, tradition and freedom of each province."
                                                                                                                                                            - Part of the San Batavian Declaration of independence

The

San Batavia Republic

is a faction born from tragedy, of friendships and promises betrayed, and from a people who refused to stand aside while worlds burned in the name of a long dead nation.

While some of them seek a new start, free of the embers of the Domain, others dare to build their own shining city on a hill.

Will they be able to bring peace and liberty to the sector? Or will the price of freedom be too high?

The San Batavia Republic offers many paths forwards on the road forwards to safeguarding the stars and their ideals!

The mod features many custom ships, fighters, and portraits—the arsenal of the Republic and the people fighting for a better future among the stars.
